d: Exclusive mic'd up moments and behind the scenes footage from the 2026 NHL Global Series games in Helsinki. Hear From Shayne Gostisbehere, Taylor Hall, Jordan Martinook, Jackson Blake, and head coach Rod Brind’Amour of the Carolina Hurricanes to Matty Beniers and head coach Lane Lambert of the Seattle Kraken, watch as the defending Stanley Cup champions complete a successful overseas trip with two dominating victories at Veikkaus Arena.
